title: TIGER: Tunable-Geometry Accelerated Gradient Sliding with Adaptive Safeguards under Similarity
summary: We study distributed composite optimization under function similarity when synchronized gradient queries dominate local computation. We propose TIGER, an accelerated gradient-sliding method in problem-adapted Bregman geometry. The method applies to constrained non-Euclidean domains, allows the communicated correction term to be nonconvex, and terminates each local subproblem using a computable stationarity residual.
